title: Kestrel Care Platinum Coverage and the Closed-End Early Termination Charge — Kestrel Commercial Fleet Lease
content:
# Cross-Product Schedule — Kestrel Care Coverage and the Closed-End Early Termination Charge

**Rule.** For the early termination charge on a closed-end commercial unit of the Kestrel Commercial Fleet Lease ended before its scheduled end date by a turn-in or by a recovery after an uncured default, the termination maintenance credit is $120 where the unit's VIN is covered by an active Kestrel Care Platinum Plus or Kestrel Care Platinum Elite contract, $60 where it is covered by an active Kestrel Care Platinum contract but by no active Kestrel Care Platinum Plus or Kestrel Care Platinum Elite contract, and nothing where no active Kestrel Care Platinum, Kestrel Care Platinum Plus or Kestrel Care Platinum Elite contract covers it.

**Records read.** The Kestrel Care Vehicle Service Contract records of the business: for each such contract, the VIN it covers, its plan (Kestrel Care Powertrain, Gold, Gold Plus, Platinum, Platinum Plus or Platinum Elite) and whether its status is active. A contract covers the unit when its VIN is the VIN on the unit's schedule.

## Schedule

| Active Kestrel Care Vehicle Service Contract on the unit's VIN | Termination maintenance credit |
|---|---|
| Kestrel Care Platinum Plus | $120 |
| Kestrel Care Platinum Elite | $120 |
| Kestrel Care Platinum (and no active Platinum Plus or Platinum Elite) | $60 |
| Kestrel Care Powertrain, Gold or Gold Plus only | nothing |
| No active Kestrel Care contract on the VIN | nothing |

## Cases (hypothetical)

1. The unit's VIN is covered by a Kestrel Care Platinum Elite contract whose status is active: $120.
2. The VIN is covered by a Kestrel Care Platinum contract that has been cancelled, and by no other contract: no active contract covers it, so nothing.
3. A Kestrel Care Platinum Plus contract is active on a different vehicle of the same business, and none on this unit's VIN: nothing.
4. The VIN is covered by an active Kestrel Care Gold Plus contract: nothing.
